info.description: Config, schema, secret, durable caller-grant and KMS-authority APIs, plus the organization model credential. Owner mutations require a live Identity projection. Consumers call it through the generated clients in clients/go and clients/ts.
info.title: Putnami Config API

delete.description:
Delete plaintext configuration values for a specific dimension.

Required scopes: config.value.write.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

403.description: The caller is not allowed to access the requested scope

404.description: The requested config resource was not found

put.description:
Write plaintext configuration values for a specific dimension. The write rolls no revision: a workload reads the new value on its next deploy. The `roll` and `rollShared` query parameters and the `roll` response member are ignored and never set.

Required scopes: config.value.write.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

403.description: The caller is not allowed to access the requested scope

404.description: The requested config resource was not found

get.description:
Resolve and merge configuration values for an application environment from query parameters. Use secretsMode=reveal for plaintext secrets (requires config.secret.read or an exact runtime service-account config claim).

Required scopes: config.value.read.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

403.description: The caller is not allowed to access the requested scope

404.description: The requested config resource was not found

post.description:
Resolve and merge configuration values for an application environment. Pass secretsMode=redacted to merge secret shape without plaintext, or includeSecrets=true / secretsMode=reveal for plaintext (requires config.secret.read or an exact runtime service-account config claim).

Required scopes: config.value.read.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

403.description: The caller is not allowed to access the requested scope

404.description: The requested config resource was not found

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

403.description: The caller is not allowed to access the requested scope

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

403.description: The caller is not allowed to access the requested scope

404.description: The requested config resource was not found

post.description: Resolve one person's routine trigger for a skill in a workspace, to start that person's routine: the trigger of that skill, else the person's Putnami routine (skill putnami). Answered with Cache-Control: no-store. When agent triggers are off it answers registered false with disabled true. Service-to-service only: exact-audience Google ID token from an allowlisted dispatcher.

403.description: The caller is not an allowlisted dispatcher

503.description: The caller could not be verified

post.description: Prepare an exact accepted Config member after owner verification. Service-to-service only; callers provide no artifact bytes or acceptance receipt.

403.description: Control service identity denied

409.description: Accepted member is not verified ready

412.description: A secret the member references is not set

post.description: Resolve one opaque prepared configuration reference for the exact currently authorized workload issuer, immutable subject and audience.

403.description: Workload identity or opaque reference is not authorized

post.description: Check that every secret an exact accepted Config member references is set for its workload. The deploy calls it before it changes anything. Service-to-service only.

403.description: Caller identity denied

409.description: Deadline passed, or the member conflicts with owner evidence

412.description: A secret the member references is not set

post.description: Store an exact accepted Config member as its workload's stored configuration, and answer the workload's boot document and resolve transport. Service-to-service only.

400.description: Malformed request, or a member Config refuses to store

403.description: Caller identity denied

409.description: Deadline passed, a newer generation is recorded for the workload, or the member conflicts with the stored schema

412.description: The member is not prepared, or the boot document is refused

post.description: Resolve an explicitly granted set of plaintext secret string paths for one exact workspace/application/environment/version tuple. Service-to-service only: exact-audience Google ID token plus an allowlisted caller service account.

400.description: Malformed or out-of-bounds secret projection request

403.description: Service caller or requested secret tuple is not authorized

503.description: Service caller could not be verified because Google signing keys are unavailable

get.description:
Read what this workload's purge of one workspace deleted: per domain, when the purge started and finished, each table with the rows it deleted and the rows left, and each provider resource with its handle and whether it was re-observed absent. finished_at stays empty until every table has 0 rows left and every resource is absent. Service-to-service only.

Required scopes: workspace.lifecycle.evidence.

403.description: Service caller is not authorized

post.description: Open the lease of one run on the Anthropic API key of the workspace's organization, with the per-run budget stored now. Opening the same run again answers the same lease. Service-to-service only: exact-audience Google ID token from an allowlisted model relay.

403.description: The caller is not an allowlisted model relay

404.description: No credential or lease for this caller

409.description: The key is revoked, the run is leased to another caller, or the lease is closed, expired or superseded

503.description: Organization model credentials are not enabled, or the caller could not be verified

post.description: Close a lease with the run's usage and stop reason. A closed lease never resolves again; closing it again answers the recorded close.

403.description: The caller is not an allowlisted model relay

404.description: No credential or lease for this caller

409.description: The key is revoked, the run is leased to another caller, or the lease is closed, expired or superseded

503.description: Organization model credentials are not enabled, or the caller could not be verified

post.description: Resolve the key under an open lease, only for the relay that opened it, before its deadline and at its generation. Answered with Cache-Control: no-store.

403.description: The caller is not an allowlisted model relay

404.description: No credential or lease for this caller

409.description: The key is revoked, the run is leased to another caller, or the lease is closed, expired or superseded

503.description: Organization model credentials are not enabled, or the caller could not be verified

delete.description:
Remove the caller's own routine trigger for a skill in the workspace. Removing none succeeds.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

400.description: The URL is not a routine fire endpoint of api.anthropic.com, or the token is malformed

403.description: The caller is not a person with platform.workspace.read at the workspace

404.description: Unknown skill, or the caller has no trigger for it

503.description: Agent triggers are not enabled, or Identity is unavailable

get.description:
Read the caller's own routine trigger for a skill in the workspace: the routine id, the generation, and when it was registered and last changed. Never the token.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

400.description: The URL is not a routine fire endpoint of api.anthropic.com, or the token is malformed

403.description: The caller is not a person with platform.workspace.read at the workspace

404.description: Unknown skill, or the caller has no trigger for it

503.description: Agent triggers are not enabled, or Identity is unavailable

put.description:
Store or replace the caller's own routine trigger for a skill in the workspace: a fire URL of api.anthropic.com and the routine's token, sealed under the workspace data key. The token is write-only.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

400.description: The URL is not a routine fire endpoint of api.anthropic.com, or the token is malformed

403.description: The caller is not a person with platform.workspace.read at the workspace

404.description: Unknown skill, or the caller has no trigger for it

503.description: Agent triggers are not enabled, or Identity is unavailable

get.description:
List concrete config apps and environments in a workspace. Requires platform.workspace.read resolved at the target workspace; returns metadata only.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

403.description: Insufficient workspace permissions

404.description: Config version not found

get.description:
Compute a deterministic server-side diff between two current or frozen config snapshots. Secret leaves remain fixed redaction markers on both sides. Requires platform.workspace.read resolved at the target workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

403.description: Insufficient workspace permissions

404.description: Config version not found

get.description:
Read Config's current persistent workspace KMS authority.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

put.description:
Ensure and activate the server-derived workspace-named KMS key using expectedRevision CAS. Callers cannot select a project, location, key ring, or key URI.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

post.description:
Revoke Config's workspace KMS authority using expectedRevision CAS. A tombstone never falls back to Runtime placement.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

get.description:
Read the redacted status of the Anthropic API key of the workspace's organization: state, generation, per-run budget, and who changed it and when. Never the key. Requires platform.organization.manage resolved at that organization.

Required scopes: platform.organization.manage.

403.description: The caller does not hold platform.organization.manage at the workspace's organization

404.description: The organization has no model credential

409.description: The generation moved, or the key is already revoked

503.description: Organization model credentials are not enabled, or Identity is unavailable

put.description:
Store or replace the Anthropic API key of the workspace's organization, sealed under that organization's KMS key, with its per-run budget (default 2,000,000 tokens and 900 seconds of model time). The key is write-only. Requires platform.organization.manage resolved at that organization.

Required scopes: platform.organization.manage.

403.description: The caller does not hold platform.organization.manage at the workspace's organization

404.description: The organization has no model credential

409.description: The generation moved, or the key is already revoked

503.description: Organization model credentials are not enabled, or Identity is unavailable

post.description:
Revoke the organization's key at the generation the caller read. Every open lease stops resolving. Requires platform.organization.manage resolved at that organization.

Required scopes: platform.organization.manage.

403.description: The caller does not hold platform.organization.manage at the workspace's organization

404.description: The organization has no model credential

409.description: The generation moved, or the key is already revoked

503.description: Organization model credentials are not enabled, or Identity is unavailable

get.description:
Resolve a current or frozen config snapshot with every secret leaf replaced by a fixed redaction marker. There is no reveal mode. Requires platform.workspace.read resolved at the target workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

403.description: Insufficient workspace permissions

404.description: Config version not found

get.description:
List Config-owned caller grants for one exact workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

Read the durable grant and key-authority mutation audit for one workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

Read one Config-owned caller grant and its CAS revision.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

put.description:
Create or replace one exact caller capability using expectedRevision CAS. Secret-read grants require an exact app/environment/version/path set; config-read grants carry no secret coordinates.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

post.description:
Immediately revoke one exact caller grant using expectedRevision CAS.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

get.description:
List every configuration key and secret name the app's registered schema declares in one environment, whether each is a secret and required, and whether the live view holds a value for it (set or missing). Requires config.secret.read resolved at the target workspace; returns no value, default or hash of a value.

Required scopes: config.secret.read.

403.description: Insufficient workspace permissions

404.description: Config version not found

get.description:
Read the workspace's telemetry settings: the workspace row, each service override in service order, and the settings each overridden service ends with, field by field. An unset field takes the framework default. Requires platform.workspace.read at the workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

400.description: Malformed workspace, service or field value

403.description: Insufficient workspace permissions, or a machine token

put.description:
Replace the workspace's telemetry settings row, or one service's override when service is set: trace budget and per-minute trace floor from 0 to 1000000, trace ratio from 0 to 1, log level debug, info, warn or error. A request with every field unset removes the row. Answers the same view as the read. Requires platform.workspace.manage in this request's live Identity projection of the workspace: a token-carried scope alone is refused, and so is a machine token.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

400.description: Malformed workspace, service or field value

403.description: Insufficient workspace permissions, or a machine token

get.description:
List current plus persisted resolved-value snapshots for one config app and environment. Requires platform.workspace.read resolved at the target workspace; returns no values.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

403.description: Insufficient workspace permissions

404.description: Config version not found
